source.quote: We expect 2026 consolidated organic revenue growth to be in the mid-single-digit range as compared to our full year 2025 results.
We expect to improve adjusted EBITDA margin to a range of 26.5% to 27% in 2026, assuming current forward FX rates that I just mentioned.

Once completed, we expect to improve annual operating income by between $25,000,000 and $30,000,000 compared to the trailing twelve months ended Q3 2025 as a result of both the revenue and expense impacts of these actions.
At this time, the forward FX forecast implied an approximately 1% tailwind on revenue growth for the year, and we would anticipate that to be offset with an expense increase from FX.
Our current tax rate expectation for the year is approximately 26%.
We continue to expect our full year effective tax rate to be approximately 26%.

For full year adjusted EBITDA margin, we expect improvement to approximately 27.0%, driven by approximately 200 basis points of underlying margin expansion, partially offset by approximately 90 basis points of incremental transaction costs versus 2025.
We expect our full year effective tax rate to be approximately 26% and full year capital expenditures of approximately 8.5% of revenue, primarily geared towards high-return growth investments.
